coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Pier 70 Parcel K South (PKS)
record.summary: The southern piece of the Port's 20th/Illinois Street parcel, on Illinois Street south of the new 21st Street, reserved under the 2017 approvals as a 100%-affordable housing site (65 ft under the D4D). The Port's 2026 report assigns it to Phase 2 and says its gap funding is not yet available; no developer has been selected.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- this block is not yet built and does not correspond to any subdivided Assessor parcel: it currently sits on vacant/graded land, surface parking, or an existing industrial building slated for demolition within Brookfield's 28-acre district (unaddressed in DataSF's Assessor roll). RE-TRACED 2026-09-17 directly from Figure 6.4.2 at the correct source resolution (see digitization_method) -- treat vertex positions as accurate to roughly 5-15m, not survey-grade. This deliberately does NOT match today's satellite imagery of the parking lot -- this parcel's boundary represents the D4D's planned footprint, including '21ST ST (NEW)', which is not built yet.
notes.digitized_from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 6.4.2 - Maximum Building Height (p.155).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor parcel may exist under this block (part of Brookfield's larger, largely unaddressed 28-acre site), but it has not been subdivided per the masterplan's individual named parcels -- this uses hand-traced approximate geometry instead.
notes.regulatory_context: Residential per Brookfield's own leasing brochure, 65 ft max per Figure 6.4.2 -- confirmed as a real, distinct parcel from Parcel K North (both named together, with the Hoedown Yard, in a 2017 Port Commission resolution and reaffirmed in a 2020 resolution). No source found gives a specific unit count, architect, or construction-status beyond this.

facts.value: 100% affordable housing (one of three stand-alone affordable parcels with C1B and C2A)
Port of San Francisco (Port-controlled parcel outside the developer's option)
no more than six residential stories (D4D S6.4.2)
Phase 2 (affordable) / Phase 2B in Exhibit A, with C1 (Port's 2026 report)

The 2017 Affordable Housing Plan requires at least 30% of units at the 28-Acre Site and Parcel K South be affordable, including 320 or more permanently affordable units in three buildings developed by local nonprofits; the 2026 proposal keeps a 327-unit stand-alone minimum while lowering the project-wide rate to no less than 20%
The D4D lets the Retail and Service frontage for HDY3 and HDY1/2 be combined on 22nd Street; Irish Hill Corner Plaza sits at the PKS/HDY3 corner of Illinois and 22nd

milestones.text: Port Commission approves subdividing the 20th/Illinois parcel into the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension and Parcel K South, with PKS 'developed as an affordable housing site' (Resolution 17-52 recitals)
